description: A *factoring* splits the variables of a planning task into a *center* and *leaves* for decoupled search. The X-shape factoring combines two kinds of leaves in the *causal graph*, which has an arc from `u` to `v` when some operator reads or writes `u` and writes `v`. First, every small sink component (a strongly connected component that no arc leaves) becomes a fork leaf. Then every small source component (one that no arc enters) without an arc into a fork leaf becomes an inverted-fork leaf. Every leaf touches only the center, so the result is a *strict star*.

papers.authors: Daniel Gnad, Jörg Hoffmann, Carmel Domshlak
papers.title: From Fork Decoupling to Star-Topology Decoupling
